versions.changelog:
- Initial release of flatpak-browser-open-html.
- Provides a clear workaround for opening local HTML files in flatpak browsers by using `--file-forwarding` and marker arguments.
- Documents URL encoding requirements for file paths.
- Includes troubleshooting for dead default handlers and guidance for resetting browser defaults (`xdg-mime`).
- Notes on flatpak sandbox limitations with headless screenshots and advises alternative approaches.
- Offers verification steps and applies equally to both Zen and Vivaldi flatpak browsers.
